title: Channel
description: A place the community gathers, off this site — a Discord, a subreddit, a funding page. Content rather than markup, because this is an open-source project whose leadership is expected to change hands, and the day the Discord moves should not require a code edit and a deploy by whoever still has commit rights.

platform.description: Which service this is. A closed set on purpose: it decides the icon, the label a reader sees, and — the part that matters — the hosts the URL is allowed to use. Adding a platform is an edit to this file and to the site's host allowlist, which means it goes through review. That is the one part of a channel a compromised administrator account cannot reach.

group.description: Which column it appears under. A group with no enabled channels renders nothing at all — no heading, no empty column — which is how a site with no funding page simply has no Support column rather than an empty one.

url.description: Where it goes. HTTPS only: every platform here serves it, and a downgrade has no legitimate use. The site checks the host against the platform as well, which the schema cannot express.

blurb.description: The paragraph above the group this channel belongs to. Rendered as text, never as markup.

order.description: Where it sits within its group.

enabled.description: False hides the channel without discarding its history. Turning one off is the reversible alternative to deleting it.
